title: Profiles and islands
summary: Up to five SkyBlock profiles, each with its own private island, inventory, skills and coins. Switch between them, visit other players' islands, and team up in a co-op.

profiles and switch between them whenever you like.
Every profile gets a fruit for a name, picked at random: Apple, Banana, Blueberry and so on. The first time you join, everything you already had becomes your first profile, so nothing is lost.
Each profile has a small floating island of its own: grass over dirt and stone, an oak tree, and a
Only the profile's members can break and place blocks on an island. Each island has a build area of 160 by 160 blocks around its centre.
